# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 is the verified best, with setup WNS -9.799 ns and timing still infeasible. The trial carry-save rewrite improved setup slack to -1.994 ns but was not adopted because it did not close timing; its reported critical path still crossed a DSP chain and ended in carry logic. The next attempt should reduce the multiplier count while preserving the known one-cycle behavior and every parameter value.

## Hypothesis
When the coefficient parameters are pairwise symmetric, adding each mirrored 16-bit sample pair at 17-bit signed precision before multiplying can reduce DSP use and shorten the combinational sum path, potentially improving setup WNS without worsening hold.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the delay register, synchronous active-high reset, registered `y_out`, and `// @latency 1` unchanged. Add an elaboration-time fast path for `C0==C7`, `C1==C6`, `C2==C5`, and `C3==C4`: form four sign-extended 17-bit mirrored-sample sums, multiply each by its shared signed coefficient, then combine the 32-bit products with a balanced tree. Retain a general path for all other parameter combinations that preserves the existing signed 32-bit product and sum behavior; run the unchanged verification and routed flow, and compare setup and hold against iteration 1.
